root_cause: Worker Python 3.13 invokes Megatron Makefile whose python3/python3-config resolve to old .venv Python 3.10; wrong EXT_SUFFIX and missing pybind11 headers terminate actor.
changes: Resolve CPython/pybind11 headers and ABI suffix from the actual mcore interpreter.
Retain original Makefile compiler flags and original dataset C++ algorithms; override CPPFLAGS/LIBEXT/OUT only.
Hook the compile_helpers alias in Bridge before initialize_megatron, without modifying nested Megatron repositories.
Serialize builds, validate imports, publish .so atomically and reuse compatible current artifact.
Run a CPU-only preflight before launching train/vLLM, avoiding model loading before reporting build failures.

tests.native_build: Original pinned helpers.cpp compiled under local Python 3.12.2 with pybind11 3.0.4, while PATH Python/config are intentionally wrong. Native blending-index function verified.
tests.failure_recovery: Compile failure preserves previous working .so; repeat build reuses cache without changing mtime.
tests.source_patch: Patch generated from pinned NeMo source, applied twice in tests, compared with actual files; stored patch separately applied and compared.

limitations: Local tests use Python 3.12 and CPU, not the target Python 3.13/B200 training stack.
